one_line: A 6.6-second close-up of hands squishing and stretching a soft, creamy dough, with a POV caption promising a two-ingredient recipe that the caption then spells out (cornstarch and hair conditioner).

hook.visual: Tight top-down close-up of hands kneading a pale, glossy, very soft dough on a white surface; the dough is already being squished at 0.0 s, so there is no setup shot.
hook.on_screen_text: POV: יש לך מתכון משני מצרכים בלבד לבצק הכי רך ונעים שקיים. (POV: You have a two-ingredient recipe for the softest, most pleasant dough that exists.) The words "מצרכים" and "בצק" are highlighted in red.
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Inferred: the texture is the hook. The dough is shown mid-squish from frame one, and the text names a superlative outcome (softest dough) plus a tiny effort cost (two ingredients) while withholding which two ingredients, so the viewer has to open the caption.

beats.observed: Both hands press and fold a cream-coloured dough; the surface is smooth with fine creases. The POV text is already on screen and stays on screen for the full clip.
beats.on_screen_text: POV: יש לך מתכון משני מצרכים בלבד לבצק הכי רך ונעים שקיים. (POV: You have a two-ingredient recipe for the softest, most pleasant dough that exists.)

beats.observed: Hands pinch, press and spread the dough open. At 1.0 s and 2.0 s a smaller hand is visible next to a larger one, so at least two people appear to be handling the dough (ages cannot be confirmed from frames).
A large sheet of dough is pressed flat and folded; fingers with pink nail polish pull a piece away. The dough keeps its shape without visible stickiness on the hands.
Hands lift and stretch the dough into a soft, drooping shape; at 6.0 s it sags between the fingers, showing how stretchy it is. The clip ends on this stretch.

payoff: The viewer sees the dough texture from 0.0 s and sees its stretchiness by about 5-6 s. The actual recipe (1 cup cornstarch, 1/2 cup hair conditioner, can be doubled) is only in the caption, so the full payoff is outside the video.
cta: None in the video. The caption gives the recipe and ends with a friendly sign-off; there is no explicit save, share or comment request.
share_or_comment_trigger: Inferred: parents save it as a ready sensory-play recipe made of household items, and send it to another parent with the thought of trying it with their kids. The 108 comments may include recipe questions or tags, but comment content is not in the data.
why_it_worked: 486,329 views against an account median of 15,382 (outlier_x 31.6): a 6.6 s clip is easily rewatched, and a rewatch loop is a likely driver of reach (inferred).
The two-ingredient promise gives a low-effort, high-reward reason to open the caption and save the recipe; the recipe is only in the caption (observed from meta.json).
like_rate 0.37% is modest for a big outlier, which suggests a broad audience reached by the recommendation feed rather than a loyal one (inferred).
paid_signal: no | like_rate 0.37% is above the 0.3% threshold that would suggest paid promotion, so there is no sign of a boost; it is not conclusive.

solo_route.how: 1) Film a tight top-down shot of your own hands working with a tactile material (dough, a fresh printed book page being turned, paper being unwrapped) on a plain white surface with window light. 2) In CapCut or Canva, add the POV caption as a two-line text block with the key nouns in red, kept on screen for the whole clip. 3) Keep the clip under 8 seconds and cut so the last frame leads back to the first, so it loops. 4) Put the full explanation or recipe in the caption so the clip itself stays short.
solo_route.needs: Nothing for a hands-only version. If the original used a child's hand, a LumeBook version does not need one.

lumebook_version.hook_he: POV: יש לך תמונה אחת של הילד, וספר שלם עם הילד שלך כגיבור. (POV: You have one photo of your child, and a whole book with your child as the hero.)
lumebook_version.concept: A sub-8-second, top-down hands-only clip of a LumeBook printed book being opened and its pages flipped in soft light, with a POV line in red-highlighted text, and the ordering steps (upload a photo, see a free preview, order) in the caption. Pair with a satisfying page-turn and finishing on the cover so the clip loops.

evidence_notes: Observed: hands kneading dough, the unchanged POV text, one smaller hand at 1.0-2.0 s. Spoken: the Whisper transcript is only "תודה רבה." over the full 6.4 s, which is almost certainly a Whisper hallucination over music or silence; there is no usable speech transcript. Inferred: the loop, the sensory appeal and the share motive. The ingredients (cornstarch, hair conditioner) come from the caption only, not from anything shown in the frames. Not verified: whether the dough is safe for young children or edible, and whether the video is one continuous shot or cuts. Account fit: the poster's name says parent guidance and behavior analysis, so this sensory-recipe clip is off its usual topic. Cannot identify the people whose hands appear.
